verdict.rationale: dlt's own docs say it 'has an interface to add custom destinations to create reverse ETL pipelines,' and it can query modeled warehouse data via pipeline.dataset(). That is a documented, purpose-stated path for reverse ETL, but the engineer must write the sync code to each SaaS tool. Missing for 10: prebuilt CRM/ads/support destinations, documented field mapping/upsert semantics for SaaS targets, worked reverse-ETL examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I sync modeled warehouse data back into SaaS tools (CRM, ads, support) to activate it where teams work

citations.quote: has an interface to add custom destinations to create reverse ETL pipelines
use `pipeline.dataset()` to query the data. You can build the query with data frame expressions, Ibis, or SQL.
